name: Tohoten Otome
source: The head of the political party Party of Words. [spoiler]Mother of Shibuya Division's Arisugawa Dice.[/spoiler] In the first year of the H calendar, she staged a coup d'état using the Hypnosis Mic and seized power. She enacted the H Act herself, abolished military force from the country, and built a female-centered society. She is the organizer of the Division Rap Battle, where participants compete in raps using the Hypnosis Mic. She has high ideals and overwhelming drive, and has gained tremendous support from party members.
